messages:
Kyla Martin: Hi team! I'm Kyla (she/her) — starting today in Product Eng. Hoping someone can quick orient me on laptop setup & who to ping for VPN/KMS access. Also, where do I find the welcome swag form? :wave:

Ashley Gomez: Welcome @Kyla! :tada: For MDM/okta + laptop imaging ping Jen (cc below). For VPN access, DM eng-infra or open a ticket in #eng-infra. Swag form is at https://forms.redwood.example/welcome-swags

Jen Park: Hi Kyla — adding you to our provisioning queue. Please send me your employee ID and preferred shipping address in a DM. I'll kick off MDM and Okta invites. ETA ~2 business days.

Michael Li: hey kyla! if you want a dotfiles jumpstart, I can fork my ~/.config and share a quick script. also, if you need quick access to sandbox GPUs for development, tell me which models/containers you plan to run.

Kyla Martin: Thanks all! @Jen DM sent. Michael — that'd be awesome, thanks. For GPUs, just general dev sandbox (small tests) — nothing heavy yet.

Infra Bot: [provisioning] Ticket #INF-2021 created for VPN/KMS access. Assigned to eng-infra. Status: open.

Samir Rao: Welcome Kyla! When you get a moment, check out the onboarding doc in Confluence: https://redwood.internals/onboarding/new-hire-developer. It has a checklist (email groups, pager rotations, codebase links).

Ashley Gomez: FYI — meet-and-greet 1:1s are at 3pm PT today with the product team. I'll invite you. Also we'll do a quick run of infra orientation on Thursday.

Kyla Martin: Got it, thanks everyone — excited to be here! :sparkles:

Jen Park: Quick note for MDM: if the laptop is Apple Silicon, let me know. We ship the correct charger and dongles. :package:

Michael Li: added a tiny script here if you want to bootstrap: ```bash
curl -fsSL https://gist.redwood.example/kyla-setup.sh | bash
``` runs basic dotfiles + ssh-keys prompt.

Kyla Martin: Perfect — running that after I finish lunch. Appreciate the warm welcome! :heart:
